snippet.title: CAVE! CAVE! DEUS VIDET game teaser
snippet.description:
Free download of Episode 0 available here: http://www.cavecavedeusvidet.com/
Support Episode 1 on Steam Greenlight here: http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=322685237

A visual novel made with Ren'Py for Bosch Art Game international competition 2013. 
Inspired by the works of Jheronimus Bosch.

Game teaser music: "B005" by Monroeville Music Center, from the album "Generic Product" (http://monroevillemusiccenter.bandcamp.com/album/generic-product)

More info at http://www.wearemuesli.it/
